verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Datadog publishes an official CLI, datadog-ci, documented in its GitHub repository, so the core of the story (an official CLI exists) is met. Nothing else in the pack describes what the CLI covers, how to install or authenticate it, or how it fits agent-driven or AI-native workflows, so support rests on a single existence check. Missing for 10: documentation of the CLI's command surface and scope beyond its name, evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented usage (e.g., scriptable/JSON output, agent workflows), independent or hands-on corroboration.
